acceptance: Each of the four triggers has a test that starts it with a fixture event
A duplicate item at add is refused or flagged
An item whose acceptance merged is proposed for consume within the same boundary
After one wave, evolve inbox rank lists zero open items for built work
A re-scope, split or merge case becomes a typed proposal for the X13 orchestrator, and the pipeline validates it before any change
fix: Add four triggers. (1) On add, in the P3 intake: validate origin, kind, fix surface and route against the protected fence, run the overlap pre-check against open items, and rank on write. (2) On landing (the ship.landed event and the console merge): compare the merged change and the acceptance of the closed items with the open items, and propose consume for each item whose acceptance is now met. (3) On a change of the policy or of the protected manifest: check each route again. (4) At the boundary: one sweep that catches missed events, plus the P4 preemption. Send each judgment case (re-scope, split, merge) to the X13 orchestrator (item selfheal-orchestrator-agent-profile) as a typed proposal that the pipeline validates.
